name: Legacy: Evaluation Pass Rate Over Time

queries.name: main
queries.sql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(OccurredAt) AS bucket,
  countIf(Passed = 1) AS passed,
  countIf(isNotNull(Passed)) AS scored
FROM evaluation_metrics
WHERE OccurredAt >= {period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {period_end:DateTime}
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
